facts.text: Serve the snacks when the squad cuts loose in a Corto Maltese bar.
facts.why: In the transcript the squad stops at a Corto Maltese bar to kill time, orders a round of Fernets and toasts to being alive in three hours. Wikipedia also mentions a cut sequence outside the bar.

facts.text: Dad always said never fight on an empty stomach. So we eat first.
facts.why: Not a line on the Wikiquote page. As a note it claims something about Ratcatcher 2's father that the sources opened do not support. A short real line of hers fits the length.
facts.fix: If I die because I gambled on love, it will be a worthy death.
